title: Fix footnote rendering and table alignment in signatures.md
description: Improves Markdown formatting in signatures.md by replacing escaped backslash footnote markers (`\*`) with proper list-style footnotes and widening table columns for better alignment. This is a documentation-only change with no impact on the protocol specification itself.
impact: Documentation readers benefit from improved readability of signature specification tables; no changes required for implementers.
author: aksbro-gpu

title: Simplify catalog example annotations using op+direction lookup
description: Replaces explicit `def=` selectors in catalog example annotations with automatic `op+direction` resolution, where the validator derives `$defs/{op}_{direction}` automatically. The `def=` parameter is retained for non-operation shapes like transport error responses or profile sub-types. The validation script is updated to implement this automatic fallback logic.
impact: Documentation authors and tooling consumers benefit from simpler example annotations; no protocol behavior changes affect API implementers.
author: igrigorik

title: Reject registerTool() promise on AbortSignal abort
description: Changes `registerTool()` to return a rejected promise (with the abort reason) when the provided `AbortSignal` is already aborted or becomes aborted, replacing the previous behavior of silently returning or logging a console warning. Also fixes `unregisterTool` to return early instead of asserting when a tool is not found in the tool map.
impact: Developers using `registerTool()` with an `AbortSignal` must now handle promise rejection with the abort reason, as silent/warning-only returns are no longer specified.
author: beaufortfrancois

title: Add cart_id cross-reference in Create Checkout docs
description: Adds a documentation note to the Create Checkout section explaining that when the Cart capability is negotiated, the request payload accepts an additional `cart_id` field for cart-to-checkout conversion. The note cross-links to the Cart specification's Cart-to-Checkout Conversion section for the full field contract.
impact: Developers implementing cart-to-checkout conversion flows will find improved discoverability of the `cart_id` field directly from the Create Checkout documentation.
author: matthutchinson

title: Clarify get_product unrecoverable error severity in catalog docs
description: Updates the catalog error severity note to reflect that `get_product` returns `severity: "unrecoverable"` when an identifier cannot be resolved, rather than the recoverable default. Agents must not retry the same `id` in this case, and the note now links to REST and MCP examples for reference.
impact: Developers implementing catalog agent logic should update retry handling to skip retries when `get_product` returns an unrecoverable error for an unresolvable product ID.
author: dylanfarrell

title: Add Catalog Response Metadata to Schema Reference Docs
description: Adds a missing 'Catalog Response Metadata' section to the schema reference page, rendering the `ucp` object fields for catalog responses. This fixes a documentation gap where the `response_catalog_schema` definition was not being surfaced alongside other response metadata sections.
impact: Developers referencing the schema documentation will now find the catalog response `ucp` metadata fields properly documented alongside cart and order response metadata.
author: sakinaroufid

title: Add Discovery Section to Checkout REST Binding Docs
description: Adds a missing Discovery section to the checkout REST binding specification, documenting how businesses advertise REST transport availability via their UCP profile at `/.well-known/ucp`. Includes a JSON example showing the expected profile structure with services, capabilities, and transport fields.
impact: Developers implementing or integrating the checkout REST binding gain documentation on how to discover and advertise REST transport support through UCP profiles.
author: Mubeen-Fatima

title: Bump GitHub Actions versions for Node 24 compatibility
description: Updates multiple GitHub Actions dependencies to newer major versions to ensure compatibility with Node 24 runtime. Actions updated include actions/checkout (v4→v5), actions/cache (v4→v5), actions/github-script (v7→v8), actions/create-github-app-token (v1→v2), astral-sh/setup-uv, tj-actions/changed-files, and streetsidesoftware/cspell-action. Also bumps js-yaml to 4.2.0 in package-lock.json.
impact: Repository contributors and maintainers will see CI workflows running on updated action versions with Node 24 compatibility; no changes to the protocol specification itself.
author: damaz91

title: Add AI coding agent contributor guidelines files
description: Adds AGENTS.md as a central operating contract for AI coding agents contributing to the repository, covering context initialization, schema editing rules, commit conventions, and local validation commands. CLAUDE.md is added as a thin wrapper that references AGENTS.md for Claude-specific agent compatibility.
impact: AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Codex) working in this repository will now automatically load contributor guidelines, improving consistency in schema edits, commit formatting, and documentation updates.
author: nicholasjameshall

title: Add W3C Security and Privacy Self-Review Questionnaire
description: Adds a completed W3C security and privacy self-review questionnaire for the WebMCP specification, covering 22 standard questions about information exposure, PII handling, cross-origin behavior, and security considerations. The document addresses key risks including tool over-parameterization, cross-origin tool discovery via `exposedTo`, permission policy gating, and BFCache/disconnection behavior.
impact: No implementation changes required; this is documentation only, intended for W3C reviewers and implementers evaluating the security and privacy posture of WebMCP.
author: victorhuangwq
